name: Simple Safety Policy
description: Balanced policy for shopping and research agents. Blocks dangerous domains, requires approval for payments and high-risk actions, and protects PII.

rules.name: Block high-risk financial domains
rules.description: Prevent any interaction with banking, crypto exchanges, or payment processors

rules.name: Require approval for checkout flows
rules.description: Any submit action on a checkout or payment page must be reviewed by a human

rules.name: Risk threshold enforcement
rules.description: Actions scoring 70 or higher require explicit human approval

rules.name: Protect PII
rules.description: Any action that appears to transmit personally identifiable information is blocked

rules.name: Safe navigation default
rules.description: Navigation to allow-listed retail domains is permitted without review
